stock.label: Stock list
stock.empty: No ingredients are tracked here yet.

dropped.other: {count} lines were for parts the dish no longer has. They go when you save.

offNote.other: {count} dishes are off the menu because an ingredient ran out

prep.title: Made here

production.body: How much you made. What it uses comes off the stock.
production.none: Nothing here is made as prep yet. In More › Ingredients, open an ingredient and turn on "Made here" (gravy, dough…).

dashboard.topUsed: Most used by orders, last 30 days
dashboard.priceMoves: Prices that moved most, last 30 days

counts.startBody: Count what is on the shelves. Service can carry on while you count.
counts.hint: Staff count without seeing the expected amount. A manager checks the differences and applies the count.
counts.empty: No counts yet. Counting once a week shows what goes missing.
counts.countHint: Enter what you find. Each item saves when you move on; leave an item empty if you did not count it.
counts.expectedHint: Expected is the stock when the count started. Big differences need a reason before applying.
counts.waiting: Sent for review. A manager applies it.
counts.whyError: Say why: the difference is big.

errors.open: Count #{number} is still open for some of these items. Finish or cancel it first.
errors.closed: This count has already moved on. Reopen it to see.

counts.allMatchBody: What is on the shelves matches the stock exactly. Great counting!

transfers.sendBody: The stock leaves this branch now, at what it cost here. The other branch confirms what arrives.
transfers.oneBranch: Transfers need another branch in this restaurant.
transfers.receiveHint: Change a quantity if less arrived. What did not arrive is recorded as lost on the way.
transfers.arrivedError: Between nothing and what was sent.
transfers.closed: This transfer has already been received or cancelled.

done.cancel: Called back. The stock is here again.

usage.hint: Compares what the kitchen really used with what your recipes say it should have used. If more went than recipes and recorded waste explain, it shows as missing.
usage.countedAt: Last count in this period: {time}. Actual usage is right up to then.
usage.noCount: No count was applied in this period, so actual usage only shows what was recorded. Count stock for the real picture.
usage.empty: Nothing was used in this period.
usage.missingHint: Missing means more went than recipes and recorded waste explain. Check portion sizes, waste that was not recorded, or stock taken. More than expected usually means a delivery or count was not recorded.

expiry.title: Expiry
expiry.hint: Stock is kept in batches with their last good day. The kitchen uses the earliest first and is warned before it expires.
expiry.startHint: What's in stock now becomes one batch without a date. Set its date on the item's page.
expiry.shelfLifeHint: Fills in the date when it comes in. Leave empty to type the date each time.
expiry.shelfLifeError: A whole number of days, 1 to 3650.
expiry.warnError: A whole number of days, 0 to 60.
expiry.splitHint: Part of it has another date? Split it off.
expiry.splitError: Less than what is left in the batch.

setup.notAllowed: Inventory is not set up yet. Ask a manager to set it up here.

ingredients.short: What you buy for the kitchen

opening.title: Enter what you have now
opening.short: Today's stock, like a stock sheet

levels.title: When should we warn you?
levels.short: The amount at which you re-order

recipes.title: Link dishes to ingredients

ingredients.body: Tick what your kitchen buys. You can change names and units later, and add your own at the bottom.
ingredients.yours: Already in your restaurant (not counted at this branch yet)

recipes.optional: You can skip this. Counting stock and recording wastage work without recipes.

finish.title: Finish setting up
finish.body: {done} of 4 steps done. The last steps make warnings and stock more accurate.

quick.before: You counted {quantity} earlier. Change it if needed.

tips.label: What does this mean?
tips.missing: Stock that went but is not explained by recipes or recorded waste. Often portions are bigger than the recipe, waste was not recorded, or stock was taken.
tips.foodCost: What the ingredients cost as a share of what the food sold for. Lower is better; 30–35% is common.
tips.daysLeft: How long what you have will last, at the rate it was used over the last 2 weeks.
tips.runningOut: Not low yet, but at the rate you use it, it will run out within 3 days.
tips.expected: What the stock should be by the app, when the count started. A difference means something was not recorded.
tips.priceUp: Compared with the first delivery in the last 30 days. Change the alert level in Purchasing › Orders.

dialog.neededBy: Needed for: {names}. Stays on while they are.

orders_view.label: See orders and tables
orders_view.hint: Today's orders, the floor plan and guests' requests.

orders_take.label: Take orders
orders_take.hint: New orders and rounds at a table; change a round before cooking.

service_respond.label: Answer guests
service_respond.hint: Waiter calls and bill requests; mark food served.

payments_collect.label: Collect payments
payments_collect.hint: Cash, card or UPI at the table or counter.

cash_manage.label: Run the cash register
cash_manage.hint: Open and close the drawer, count it, pay cash in and out.

cash_review.label: Review cash and sign off
cash_review.hint: Day-end summary, reports, the difference limit and signing off each day.

kitchen_update.label: Run the kitchen
kitchen_update.hint: Start, ready and out of stock on kitchen tickets.

menu_availability_update.label: Mark dishes sold out
menu_availability_update.hint: Take a dish off the menu, or put it back.

orders_cancel.label: Cancel orders
orders_cancel.hint: Cancel whole orders. Anything paid is refunded.

refunds_give.label: Give refunds
refunds_give.hint: Give money back, and mark online refunds as received.

reservations_manage.label: Manage bookings
reservations_manage.hint: Take, change, seat and cancel reservations.

menu_manage.label: Edit the menu
menu_manage.hint: Add, change and remove dishes and categories.

tables_manage.label: Edit tables
tables_manage.hint: The floor plan and table QR codes.

tables_assign.label: Assign waiters to tables
tables_assign.hint: Give tables to waiters and clear everyone's sections.

rota_plan.label: Plan the rota
rota_plan.hint: Shift types, who works when, and publishing the week to staff.

attendance_fix.label: Fix attendance
attendance_fix.hint: Correct someone's shift in or shift out time, or add a shift they forgot.

branches_manage.label: Add and remove branches
branches_manage.hint: Open new branches or remove one.

staff_manage.label: Manage staff and roles
staff_manage.hint: Add staff, give them roles, create roles.

inventory_view.label: See stock
inventory_view.hint: Stock levels, the ledger and low-stock alerts.

inventory_manage.label: Manage inventory
inventory_manage.hint: Ingredients, opening stock, reorder levels and costs.

inventory_adjust.label: Adjust stock
inventory_adjust.hint: Correct stock up or down, with a reason.

inventory_wastage.label: Record wastage
inventory_wastage.hint: Record what was thrown away, and why.

inventory_count.label: Count stock
inventory_count.hint: Count what's on the shelves, without seeing what the system expects. A manager applies the count.

purchase_view.label: See purchasing
purchase_view.hint: Suppliers, purchase orders, deliveries and returns.

purchase_manage.label: Buy
purchase_manage.hint: Suppliers; create and send orders; record deliveries and returns; confirm prices.

purchase_approve.label: Approve orders
purchase_approve.hint: Approve orders above the limit, and set it.

purchase_receive.label: Receive deliveries
purchase_receive.hint: Record what came at the door, without prices.

staff.subtitle: Everyone who works at {branch}, and your restaurant admins. Add people, change their details, turn their sign-in off, or remove them from the team.
staff.failed: Couldn't load the staff. Try again.

errors.emailExists: Someone with this email is already on the staff here.
errors.phoneTaken: This mobile number belongs to someone else.
errors.ownAccount: You can't change your own role, turn off your own sign-in, or remove yourself.

dialog.name: Full name
dialog.passwordHint: Share it with them. They choose their own the first time they sign in.
dialog.youNote: You can change your name and contact details here. Ask another admin to change your role.
dialog.contactNote: Changing the email or mobile number signs them out. They sign in again with the new one.
dialog.youContactNote: Changing your email or mobile number signs you out on your other devices.

reset.title: New password for {name}
reset.body: They're signed out everywhere now, and choose their own password the next time they sign in.

toast.signedOut: {name} saved and signed out. They sign in with the new details.

emptyFilter.inactive: Everyone can sign in. People whose sign-in you turn off show here.
emptyFilter.removed: Nobody has been removed. People you remove from the team show here, so you can add them back.

sheet.resetHint: Set a temporary password. They choose their own when they sign in.
sheet.turnOffHint: They can't sign in until you turn it back on.
sheet.turnOnHint: They can sign in again with their password.
sheet.removeHint: Takes them off the staff. Their past orders and payments stay.

confirmOff.title: Turn off sign-in for {name}?
confirmOff.body: They're signed out now and can't sign in. Their tables are freed and an open shift is closed. Their orders and payments stay.

confirmRemove.title: Remove {name} from the team?
confirmRemove.body: They're signed out and taken off the staff list. Their name stays on past orders, payments and shifts. You can add them back any time from Removed.
confirmRemove.admin: {name} is an admin for all branches, so this removes them from every branch.

restore.title: Add {name} back?
restore.body: They join the team again and can sign in with their old password. If they've forgotten it, give them a new one after.
restore.roleGone: Their old role was deleted. Pick a role for them.

reason.label: Reason
reason.placeholder: Why? For example: on leave until 20 Nov

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Optional parts of the app this restaurant uses. Each one is on or off for all its branches.
features.inventoryOn: On for every branch: stock, recipes, suppliers, deliveries.
features.inventoryOff: Off: the restaurant works without stock, as before. Its data is kept.
features.who: Only the platform team can change this.
features.turnedOff: Inventory is off. Dishes stock had taken off are back on the menu.
